questions.stem_text: Anscombe claims that the notion of moral obligation is derived from the concept of:
Berkeley insists that heat and cold are _____.

options.A: elements of nature that do not exist independently
options.B: only things existing apart from our minds
options.C: only sensations existing in our minds

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - only sensations existing in our minds

questions.stem_text: Aesthetics deals with objects that are_____.

options.C: not visible to the human eye

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - not essential to our existence

questions.stem_text: According to Stevenson, the word "good" has a pleasing emotive meaning that fits it for:
Nathanson proposes a form of retributivism that requires all of the following except

options.A: a list of crimes ranked according to their seriousness.
options.B: a scale of punishments that correspond to the seriousness of certain crimes.
options.D: the death penalty for the most serious crimes.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - the death penalty for the most serious crimes.
